title: Blueforce enrollment V1 response
description: Accepted enrollment response. It carries the assigned WireGuard peer, the deterministic idempotency key and mandatory central_verification evidence references. It never carries a WireGuard private key, a credential, a URL, a RustDesk credential or any other confidential value. The device assembles its own configuration and keeps its own private key.

status.description: Any other value must be treated as a rejection; the device stays PENDING.

idempotency_key.description: Echo of the request key. A mismatch rejects the whole response.

enrollment_id.description: Central audit reference for this enrollment record.

address.description: Device tunnel address with prefix, for example 10.20.0.17/32.

endpoint.description: Central hub endpoint as host:port. Placeholder values are rejected locally.

server_public_key.description: Hub public key only; a private key is never accepted here.

allowed_ips.description: Comma-separated tunnel routes; must be a single line.

central_verification.description: Central evidence references. The device never invents them: without a well-formed record the ENROLLED gate fails closed, and READY additionally requires every channel to be verified.
